args.body: Hi Dmitri, I've noted your concern about the wrong item in order O3956. Due to our refund policy, I'm unable to issue a refund for this case. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
I'm sorry to hear about the late delivery of your order O3225. I've noted your concern and will process a refund of $122 as per your refund policy.
I'm sorry to hear about the damage to your order. I can issue a full refund since the issue is damaged, the order is 30 days old, and the amount is under $150. Your refund has been processed.
Hi Kemi, I'm looking into your order O2177. Since it's a late delivery and under our $150 refund limit, I'll issue a refund for the full amount of $86. You'll receive the refund shortly.

Hi Gus, I apologize for the wrong item in your order O1324. I'll process a refund for the full order amount since the issue is a 'wrong_item', the order is less than 30 days old, and the amount is within your $150 limit. Is there anything else I can assist you with?

Hi Rosa, I apologize for the wrong item in your order O8534. I've initiated a refund for the full $98 amount as the issue was a wrong_item and your order is under 30 days old. Your refund is being processed. Let me know if you need anything else.
Hi Chloe, I apologize for the delay on your order O2578. It will be delivered as soon as possible.
